lines: Thereby set indeed this transaction thought-born; therefore other-vibration as long as not rises so long one.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tenāstaṅgata evaiṣa vyavahāro vikalpajaḥ tasmātspandāntaraṃ yāvannodiyāttāvadekakam
